title: Dragons retain circling while following a distant flight target
description: Eight dragons spaced 28 blocks apart follow an unfinished orbit leg for 256 controlled ticks, with position/motion reset every eight ticks to keep their destinations distant. Hovering first initializes nodes so this does not test initial route seeding. The NoAI control remains still; the hovering control retains its phase and altitude. Random transition counts on baseline are not deterministic.
